about: The engine test files that touch Windows itself (its paths, clipboard, fonts, registry, shells, or what the platform is): they run on this computer, the rest on the lab machine when the gate has one (tools/gate-hosts.js). A file with any of those in it goes on one list or the other: windowsOnly, or portable with why it runs the same on Linux. A file in reachesButNeverCalls imports, by some path, a module that touches Windows, but never calls that part: it runs on the lab machine, and the lab run proves it.

reachesButNeverCalls.tests/locker-large.test.js: it reaches the Locker's working-folder code (attrib and icacls on Windows, chmod elsewhere), which runs only when a locked file is opened in another program (openPlain), and these tests never do that
